_comment: Task M4. One entry per mesh in robot_motors.xml's <asset> block. Consumed by scripts/compose_body_inertials.py. Every entry carries a `source`; entries whose source starts with ASSUMED are counted and printed at the top of the rebuild report so the human accepting it knows how much is guessed.

antenna.source: ASSUMED — no measurement or datasheet in this repo as of 2026-08-13 — priced from mesh volume x the process density in print_process.json. `antenna` in particular MUST stay printed: left_antenna_holder's declared inertia only reproduces when both its meshes sit at ~1250 kg/m3 (composer anchor).
